About BS Traders

Crafted with an eye for elegance.

BS Traders brings together premium fabrics and thoughtfully curated Indian fashion collections for boutiques, designers and customers who value quality and timeless style.

Where Fabric Meets Elegance

A boutique built on textiles.

Based in the AC Market of Ludhiana, Punjab, BS Traders works closely with boutiques and individual customers who are looking for fabrics and finished pieces with genuine character — from Banarasi weaves to hand-finished festive sets.

This site is a showcase of the kind of pieces we work with. For current stock, pricing and availability, our team is always a message away on WhatsApp.

Have a question about a fabric or fit?

Message the BS Traders team directly — we're happy to help you choose.
